contexts.text: From the love and consequent habit...
From custom, hypocrites have contracted a habit of composing their interiors so as to imitate good affections.
The vicious custom of taking names or sayings from the Word... SE 1304.
By education, company, and consequent habits...
These dissimilitudes are not indicated by the face, but by the habits.
It is known that habit makes a second nature...
This harmony results from the habit of life from which the delight is derived: a harmony contrary to true harmony is acquired by habit; for there are those who take pleasure in discords.
The habit (of speaking filthy and obscene things) should be guarded against, because it remains, and the offender is cast out from Societies.
In consequence of such a habit contracted in the life of the body, in the other life they seize whatever comes in their way, and conceal what they are doing and thinking.
He afterwards exercised the same artifice from habit...

Like the words of our Earth, in which if there are not ideas there is nothing of life, from custom; especially when they begin to be delighted with such speech, it becomes such a habit, that they conclude from mere forms...
As soon as there is actuality, evil puts on custom and habit, and so passes to posterity.
